symbols.name: normalized cyclic convolution
symbols.meaning: The operation sending two length-$s$ sequences $f$ and $g$ to their cyclic convolution divided by $s$.
symbols.quote: We write $f \circledast g$ for the normalized cyclic convolution of $f$ and $g$, the cyclic convolution $f \ast g$ divided by $s$.

relations.quote: A normalized cyclic convolution is a scaling of the [Cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) $f \ast g$ by $1/s$.

relations.predicate: is turned into pointwise products by
relations.quote: A normalized cyclic convolution is turned into pointwise products by the [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) $F_s$, as the rule below states.
